mapper.insert: insert into operation_log (user_id, username, module, operation, method, params, ip, cost_ms, success, error_msg, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{username}, #{module}, #{operation}, #{method}, #{params}, #{ip}, #{costMs}, #{success}, #{errorMsg}, #{createTime})
mapper.select:
select id, user_id, username, module, operation, method, params, ip, cost_ms, success, error_msg, create_time from operation_log
and module = #{module}
and (username like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or operation like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by id desc
